paper.authors: Ankur Garg, Xuemin Yu, Hassan Sajjad, Samira Ebrahimi Kahou

tiles.sub: safe responses disrupted: TRACE vs global direction

figures.title: When would generation stop?
figures.caption: Cumulative streaming risk R_t = 1 − ∏(1 − q_i) for your concept sequence and two test responses. Dotted lines mark where harmful content truly starts. The strip shows your sequence's true concept families and the tokens TRACE would edit.

figures.title: Selective edits vs one global direction
figures.caption: Sweeping the steering strength λ. TRACE edits only tokens assigned to harmful concepts (Eq. 7); the global direction shifts every token. Lower left is better.

figures.title: Did the codebook find the harmful concepts?
figures.caption: Each bar is a learned concept: its true composition (simulated ground truth) and its smoothed harmfulness score s_c (Eq. 3) computed only from response labels.

figures.title: Earlier detection costs false positives
figures.caption: Median detection position vs false-positive rate across thresholds (the paper's Figure 2 analog).
